served: Appearance Locust Devil Appearance The Locust Devil appears as a tall, broad-shouldered humanoid with a heavily segmented, insect-like body. Its head is small relative to its torso and lacks distinct human features, instead resembling an insectoid mask, and a pair of long, thin antennae extend from its head, further emphasizing its insectoid nature. Its physique is bulky and asymmetrical, covered in uneven, chitinous plating that gives it a crude, swarm-formed obsolete appearance. It has four thick arms ending in large, blunt hands with short, claw-like fingers, and unevenly proportioned legs. Four large, rigid wings resembling those of a locust extend from its back. These elongated, overlapping wings dominate its silhouette when viewed from behind, emphasizing its association with swarms rather than flight. Its overall posture is rigid and imposing, evoking both predatory stillness and the threat of sudden movement. Trivia Locust Devil Trivia It has been theorized that Seraphim, one of Chainsaw Man's followers, could be related with the Locust Devil as both of them resemble locusts. Trivia Locust Devil Trivia In the Book of Revelation, locusts emerge from the abyss after the fifth trumpet, not as a typical famine but as demonic tormentors, stinging people (those without God's seal) like scorpions for five months, causing intense agony where people seek death but can't find it, a symbolic judgment echoing Old Testament plagues but distinct from the famine brought by Famine (the Black Rider). These otherworldly locusts look like horses with human faces, golden crowns, and lion's teeth, described as having power to torment, not kill, highlighting spiritual judgment. Summary Chapter 227 Summary Noticing that his right arm is missing and that the Locust Devil is still alive, Denji asks Asa what the Devil’s deal is, only to receive an uncertain response. The Locust Devil charges at him but is knocked away, before latching onto Denji with its intestine scarf and hurling him through multiple buildings. Buried beneath the rubble, Denji is left unable to move as the Locust Devil unleashes successive swarms of locusts upon him. Recovering enough from her earlier injuries, Asa throws Denji his severed arm. Using the chains attached to it, he reels the Locust Devil toward him and finishes it off. As he devours the corpse, Asa asks if he is alright, to which Denji replies that the Devil tastes like shrimp. Asa smiles, but is immediately overtaken by Yoru, who shoots Denji through another building, tearing off his left arm in the process. Denji protests that the attack is unfair, only for Yoru to fire again, this time blasting him into a flock of pigeons and destroying both of his legs. Seemingly immobilized, Denji watches as Yoru approaches and prepares to shoot him once more. served: Origin Prophecy of Nostradamus Origin The Prophecy finds its origin in the real world. Nostradamus' original writings were written in archaic French and is notoriously vague and difficult to translate. As such, there are many translations of this particular Prophecy (officially named Quatrain X.72). The following translation comes from the book "The Secrets of Nostradamus" by David Ovason: Trivia Death Devil Trivia Nostradamus' quatrain about a "great King of Terror" coming in the seventh month of 1999 was interpreted by some as predicting a catastrophic event, possibly linked to a solar eclipse, while others focused on the "King of Terror" being a specific individual or event. The total solar eclipse that occurred on August 11, 1999 (July 29 in the Julian calendar), over Europe and parts of Asia, was seen by some as a fulfillment of the Prophecy, with the "King of Terror" being interpreted as either the eclipse itself or a figure associated with it. However, others argue that the Prophecy was misinterpreted, with the "King of Terror" referring to something entirely different, like a political figure or a financial crisis. Personality Death Devil Personality Per Nostradamus' Prophecy, the Death Devil is to bring about the apocalypse, end humanity, and usher in the Age of Devils. However, it is shown that Death genuinely loves human culture beyond the personal pleasures of food, having attempted to kill herself to ensure she would never end humanity, while continuing to actively thwart the Prophecy in other ways. Thus, proving the supposed "Great King of Terror" does ultimately side with humanity over Devils. She has also been shown to have cannibalistic tendencies, choosing to eat people alive rather than quickly killing them so she can savor the flavor, even with the Famine Devil (who is both her sister and a fellow Devil whose flesh would taste bad to other Devils).(Chapter 199) Chapter 199 Prophecy of Nostradamus Prophecy of Nostradamus Prophecy of Nostradamus Prophecy of Nostradamus Type: organization Allegiance: Devils Notable Members: Death Devil Manga Debut: Chapter 122 (Mentioned) In the seventh month of 1999, a Great King of Terror will descend. Characters Introduced / Mentioned Control Devil arc Characters Introduced / Mentioned Weapon Devils Overview / Physiology Devil Overview / Physiology Due to their nature of existence, Devils do not typically have familial relationships. However, there are instances where more powerful Devils regard other Devils as their children. This was first seen when Yoru referred to the Gun Devil and Tank Devil as her "children", given how guns and tanks are weapons typically associated with warfare.(Chapter 176) Whether Yoru regards them as her children due to their connection with war or the Devils were directly created or birthed from Yoru is unclear. Yoru also implies that there are strict social hierarchies among Devils, stating that bullying is common due to a lack of social fluidity when she comments on Asa's classmates bullying her. Chapter 176 Overview / Origin Devil Overview / Origin Devils are beings born from humanity's collective fear of specific concepts, all first manifesting in Hell. They are born with a "name" that correlates to a concept. These can range from highly tangible (Fish, Tomato) to entirely abstract (Future, Curse). The concept does not have to refer to something that exists; there is no indication that ghosts, zombies or angels exist in the world, yet all these names have corresponding Devils. Each name is unique to its respective Devil, though some overlap based on specificity is possible, as there have been both a War Devil and a World War II Devil. Devils manifest according to the collective consciousness surrounding their names (for example: the Gun Devil appears to be constructed out of guns and has gun-related abilities). They are the conceptual and physical embodiment of the "name" they represent. So long as the "name" of the concept still exists and is feared by the public consciousness, they continue to reincarnate. It is implied by the Falling Devil that animal fears play a role in a Devil’s power. Its face, which emerges from the split head of an old person with long hair, is a smooth surface with only a mouth, connected by several strings to the two halves of the previous face. The Aging Devil's feet have raised heels, similar to stiletto shoes. It sits on a throne made of flesh and bones, with human fingers decorating the back and tongues, mouths and teeth protruding from the base which is supported by the backs of two naked men with their hands cut off. Some authors refer to it as gerontophobia, although this may also refer to the fear of the elderly. Their car swerves off road and crashes into a wooded area, in which the three brothers emerge, and fatally shoot the passengers. Afterwards, the brothers place the dead devil hunters in body bags and leave them in the forest. served: Abilities / Devil Powers Cosmo Abilities / Devil Powers Total Understanding: Cosmo can telepathically send a person’s mind into her own mind, which seems to be a dimensional space that resembles a gigantic library. She would then force the target to understand everything in the universe. This renders them into a semi-catatonic state in which they are "only able to think of Halloween until they die." Once this occurs, the victim will be unable to think or say anything other than the phrase "Halloween" until their death. It is heavily implied that the target needs to copy Cosmo saying “Halloween” after she says it, and possibly for there to be some kind of direct focus, in order to work. What's more, Cosmo seems to be able to control the degree of her power and how much knowledge she infuses into her victim. This is evidenced when a server at a restaurant was able to say words other than Halloween despite Cosmo using her ability on him, and when Quanxi told Cosmo to give Santa Claus an all-out Halloween. Omniscience: Cosmo has all the knowledge of the universe inside her head. This essentially gives her a possibility to be omniscient. However, due to the fact that Cosmo herself appears to be affected by her power, likely because of her weakened state due to being a fiend, she is unable to utilize or access this knowledge in any meaningful way, being only able to think and say the word "Halloween". served: Abilities Mannequin Devil Abilities As a Devil, the Mannequin Devil possesses all of the standard devil abilities. Mannequin Mimicry: The Mannequin Devil's main ability, which is to transform mannequins into doppelgangers of anyone who touches it. Using those bodies, it can not only mimic the appearance of his original target, but also copy their abilities and read their thoughts to a certain extent. This ability, which allows the Mannequin Devil to transform mannequins into copies of people, can be considered the opposite of the Doll Devil's main ability, which can instead transform people into dolls. Appearance Mannequin Devil Appearance The Mannequin Devil's true form is described as a tiny, battered doll binded together with black feathers. When using its powers, it can mimic the likeness of anyone that touches one of its blank mannequin host bodies. Personality Mannequin Devil Personality Although not much is known about the Mannequin Devil's personality, it is shown to be sadistic and deceiving when attacking Kishibe, Quanxi, and Minami using their likeness for its mannequin hosts. It harbors a strong desire to copy the appearances of those who come into physical contact with them. Abilities Mannequin Devil Abilities Mannequin Possession: The Mannequin Devil is able to possess multiple mannequins that he chooses to control. Using this ability, it can jump from one mannequin to another to avoid being killed if one of his bodies ends up being destroyed. Trivia Mannequin Devil Trivia The Mannequin Devil derives its power from Automatonophobia, the fear of anthropomorphic figures, such as dolls, mannequins, robots, and animatronics. It is often confused with Pediophobia (from Greek παιδῐ́ον: "child"), which is specifically the fear of dolls. In essence, pediophobia is a type of automatonophobia, as dolls fall into the broader category of anthropomorphic figures that cause anxiety in people with automatonophobia. History / Nine Years' Savior Mannequin Devil History / Nine Years' Savior Kishibe and Quanxi both learn that the Mannequin Devil can control many mannequins that it possesses, as well as gaining the abilities and thoughts of those who have touched them. The Mannequin Devil decides to use Kishibe's likeness on its mannequins to finish off the duo as it is unable to fully mimic Quanxi. Quanxi then swiftly defeats all mannequin doppelgangers around the area, with Kishibe barely managing to defend himself in the crossfire. Afterward, the Mannequin Devil's true form is revealed and is slain by Quanxi herself, ending the threat. History / Nine Years' Savior Mannequin Devil History / Nine Years' Savior It is revealed that the Mannequin Devil had fled into one of its mannequin hosts, this time taking on the appearance of Quanxi due to her touching the Devil when destroying one of its bodies. Types of Contracts / Devil Transformation Contract Types of Contracts / Devil Transformation A type of contract where a human can gain a monstrous or very inhuman form is called a "devil transformation". This appears to be different from the contract with hybrids and the forms that have been seen appear even more inhuman than them. As devils fused into hybrids will gain a mostly permanent fusion with the human who became one, devil transformations seem to be a human's own transformation derived from the devil they contracted with but without the same exact function or triggers shown like a hybrid. A person's own individual devil transformation can look unique even if those individuals contracted with the same exact devil. The people who have devil transformations that we've seen so far are: The Yakuza's contracts with the Zombie Devil, Santa Claus' contract with the Doll Devil and the Darkness Devil, the Class President, Yuko, an unnamed elder, the Fake Chainsaw Man and the Chainsaw Man Church's members' contracts with the Fire Devil. It is unknown how many people with a devil transformation can easily turn back into their human form as Yuko said that she became a "devil" and was trying to find her devil hunter relative who she said can turn her into a human again. However, the encounter with the Fake Chainsaw Man proves that humans transformed into devils can turn back into humans and have their consciousness restored by controlling the devil's power that transformed them. Trivia Santa Claus Trivia Santa Claus is the second character seen to have a devil transformation, the first ones being the Yakuza. Given her nature as a hivemind, even if her supposed main body was destroyed, the mind of Santa Claus exists in the other dolls. The reason she is considered incapacitated and not dead is because she is still alive through the dolls but mentally damaged. List of Known Devils / Devil Transformations Devil List of Known Devils / Devil Transformations Devil Transformations are the result of humans making contracts between Devils to gain a devilish form, effectively becoming extensions of these Devils. Unlike the Hybrids, they take on a much more monstrous form, cannot freely transform back into humans, don't have the same triggers and aren't merged with the Devil they contracted with. The source of a Devil transformation can originate from more than one Devil. served: List of Known Devils / Devil Transformations Devil List of Known Devils / Devil Transformations Devil Transformations are the result of humans making contracts between Devils to gain a devilish form, effectively becoming extensions of these Devils. Unlike the Hybrids, they take on a much more monstrous form, cannot freely transform back into humans, don't have the same triggers and aren't merged with the Devil they contracted with. The source of a Devil transformation can originate from more than one Devil. According to Yuko, it appears that humans are transformed into actual Devils, and need help from an outside source to turn back.(Chapter 111) Chapter 111 Abilities / Devil Contracts Yuko Abilities / Devil Contracts Devil Transformation: The contract gave Yuko the ability to transform into an enhanced form. After surviving the battle against Yoru and Chainsaw Man, she was permanently stuck in a halfway form with traits from both her human and transformed forms. Types of Contracts / Devil Transformation Contract Types of Contracts / Devil Transformation A type of contract where a human can gain a monstrous or very inhuman form is called a "devil transformation". This appears to be different from the contract with hybrids and the forms that have been seen appear even more inhuman than them. As devils fused into hybrids will gain a mostly permanent fusion with the human who became one, devil transformations seem to be a human's own transformation derived from the devil they contracted with but without the same exact function or triggers shown like a hybrid. A person's own individual devil transformation can look unique even if those individuals contracted with the same exact devil. The people who have devil transformations that we've seen so far are: The Yakuza's contracts with the Zombie Devil, Santa Claus' contract with the Doll Devil and the Darkness Devil, the Class President, Yuko, an unnamed elder, the Fake Chainsaw Man and the Chainsaw Man Church's members' contracts with the Fire Devil. It is unknown how many people with a devil transformation can easily turn back into their human form as Yuko said that she became a "devil" and was trying to find her devil hunter relative who she said can turn her into a human again. However, the encounter with the Fake Chainsaw Man proves that humans transformed into devils can turn back into humans and have their consciousness restored by controlling the devil's power that transformed them.
